reddit.title: Improved Music Transition in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on music transitions in Provincia! The colony music now features smooth transitions without hard cuts, thanks to a long equal-power crossfade that enhances the experience. This means you won't experience any awkward pauses when day turns to night or during combat. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Enhanced Music Experience in Provincia
steam.body: We're happy to announce a significant improvement to the music system in Provincia! The new long equal-power crossfade feature ensures that players experience a smooth transition between music beds during gameplay. Say goodbye to hard cuts and enjoy a more immersive colony building experience. For more details, check out our devtalk here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
